title: The VMM must uniquely identify peripherals before establishing a connection.
check_content:
Verify the VMM uniquely identifies peripherals before establishing a connection.

If it does not, this is a finding.
fixtext: Configure the VMM to uniquely identify peripherals before establishing a connection.
VulnDiscussion:
Without identifying devices, unidentified or unknown devices may be introduced, thereby facilitating malicious activity.

Peripherals include, but are not limited to, such devices as flash drives, external storage, and printers, whether physical or virtual.
